questions.question: Describe a time at Consumertrack when you conducted a needs assessment to define user requirements. How did you gather the requirements, document them, and confirm they met stakeholder needs?
In your role supporting an analytics platform through a help desk, how did you triage an issue raised by an audit team, assess its business impact, and use SQL to troubleshoot it?
You mention analyzing financial data and performing reconciliations for completeness. What checks did you perform, how did you communicate data-quality issues, and what was the resolution process?
Give an example of translating a complex analytical or technical finding into simple, actionable terms for a business client or nontechnical stakeholder.
How have you documented specifications and test cases for SQL or PL/SQL procedures, and how did you ensure developers or end users interpreted those requirements correctly?

Walk us through the route optimization tool you developed for a major retailer. What business problem was being addressed, what requirements or constraints shaped the solution, and how did you measure success?

Describe your work on the collections-process improvement initiative. How did you analyze the process, develop the probability-of-collection models, and support the business decision to realign call-center staffing?

This role requires assessing packaged-solution upgrades and translating technical release information into business recommendations. How would you evaluate a proposed application upgrade, identify impacts and risks, and present a recommendation to stakeholders?
What is your approach to writing and validating functional requirements for a system change, including checking for completeness, consistency, feasibility, and testability?

This production-support role includes on-call and after-hours incident support. How would you organize your investigation of a production issue involving data, application behavior, and multiple business stakeholders?
